question: A typist takes 40 minutes to type 2 pages. How long (in minutes) will he take to type 87 pages?2688
solution:
**Given:**

Time to type 2 pages = 40 minutes

Total pages to type = 87

**Formula Used:**

Time to type 1 page = Time to type 2 pages ÷ 2

Total time to type 87 pages = Time to type 1 page × Total pages

**Calculation:**

⇒ Time to type 1 page = 40 ÷ 2

⇒ Time to type 1 page = 20 minutes

⇒ Total time to type 87 pages = 20 × 87

⇒ Total time to type 87 pages = 1740 minutes

**∴ The correct answer is 1740 minutes.**
